page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8ia.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of VRAM. It does not include local NVMe storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of a high-capacity 48 GB VRAM GPU with 128 GB of system memory offers a balanced profile for memory-intensive accelerated workloads without the overhead of local storage. The instance is suited for workloads such as medium-scale AI and machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and 3D rendering tasks that benefit from the Ada Lovelace architecture.
